snippet.title: Alien Cabal gameplay (PC Game, 1997)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Alien Cabal, Dos PC game produced by QASoft in 1997 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/alien-cabal/5862/
Watching the intro and blowing away bad guys in this old-school shooter.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
